# The Fluent helper extraction also changes the content-window frame wait

The extraction replaces two local documented functions with module-scope waitForContentFluent(win) and updates both content-audit call sites. It also removes the guarded frame callback/setTimeout fallback in favor of new Promise(win.requestAnimationFrame). Accepted code keeps a typeof-function guard for translateRoots, so the optional-call review proposal is not adopted. Callback realm visibility and Window method receiver semantics need paired harness proof; no behavior-equivalence or runtime-failure claim follows.

Scope: AxeHelpers localization and scheduling boundary.
